reason: I already have my suki nail tech on Messenger who knows my nails and does what I like, so I'd just book her, even for the wedding. Free home service in Cainta is nice, but ₱1,800 is more than I pay her and I don't know this artist's work yet.
objection: ₱1,800 per person is steep for gel, and for a wedding I don't want to gamble on someone new. Is that ₱1,800 for any design or will they add more for complicated art or extensions?
would_change_my_mind: If my suki couldn't make the wedding date and they offered a group rate for the whole entourage with real client photos I could check, I'd consider it.
